verdict.rationale: Otter documents a Public API and Webhooks (otter-docs-26, otter-docs-40, otter-docs-48) plus an MCP server exposing transcripts/summaries/action items to AI tools (otter-docs-6, otter-docs-46, otter-docs-16), supporting the core self-serve programmatic access story. However, there's no evidence of public API documentation pages, self-serve key generation flow, rate limits, or endpoint schemas, and API access appears gated to certain paid tiers rather than universally self-serve. missing for 10: public API reference/docs with endpoint details, self-serve key generation UI/instructions, independent developer confirmation of API usability.
